candidates.statement: Use a web application for Kindle reading instead of only the tablet app.

evidence_candidates.quote: I don't think there is a web application which, by the way, will will be. It will be cool.

candidates.statement: Avoid paying for news subscriptions by remaining in trial mode.
candidates.modality: 自述现状与习惯（to be honest）

evidence_candidates.quote: So for some of them I do pay subscription. But, to be honest, I just go or yeah into trial mode and never pay for them anymore.

candidates.statement: Download course PDFs to Google Drive and read them with Adobe Reader on the tablet.

evidence_candidates.quote: I actually download them to my drive. and then I use the adobe reader to read Pdf.

candidates.statement: Make reading course material in the school portal less cumbersome, because the current experience there is disliked.

evidence_candidates.quote: Cumbersome. I don't like the experience there.

candidates.statement: Reduce the number of steps needed to import course content to the iPad, because the current user experience is not seamless.
candidates.modality: 明确诉求（I can use less steps）
context: course material arrives as PDF links in the school portal
reading is done on an iPad

evidence_candidates.quote: So I think my current user experience is not so seamless.
I think that I I can use less steps to actually import this content to my ipad.

candidates.statement: Export articles from the course or assignment page straight to Google Drive without downloading them to the computer first.
candidates.modality: 明确希望（I can actually export it to drive like very easily）
context: articles are sent as links in the school portal

evidence_candidates.quote: They send some articles I can actually export it to to drive like very easily and not to download it to my computer.

candidates.statement: Have all reading, ebooks and PDFs, in one new application, because reading is currently scattered among many places.
candidates.modality: 明确希望（perhaps it can exist like a new application）
context: reading is currently scattered across several providers and apps

evidence_candidates.quote: perhaps it can exist like a like a new application, where you can actually at either ebooks or Pdfs, right?
Because, like right now, I feel all my all. My reading is is scattered among many places.

candidates.statement: Let one single application handle both PDF and ebook format for school reading, so both can be opened in one place.
candidates.modality: 明确希望（it would be very, very good）

evidence_candidates.quote: It would be very, very good if the if the same and application can handle both Pdfs and Ebook format. so I can open them in just one single place.

candidates.statement: Let the existing Kindle app manage PDFs, which is judged easier than a separate standalone application.
candidates.modality: 比较性偏好（it will be easier）

evidence_candidates.quote: I would say, it will be easier if my existing kindle app can manages Pdfs.
No, not really or at least not that I know you can.

candidates.statement: Provide an export feature in the portal that sends material to Google Drive or to the Kindle account.
context: ideal feature of the school web portal

evidence_candidates.quote: I am thinking right now as export feature, like export to yeah export to Google drive or export to.

candidates.statement: Show the percentage of the chapter currently being read, not only the overall percentage of the book, so that reading causes less anxiety.
candidates.modality: 明确希望（I would love to have）
context: the application already shows time remaining for the chapter

evidence_candidates.quote: What I will love for this application to also show it's to actually show you how much percentage of the chapter you are right now
So I would love to have like by chapter, you know, by chapter. This way I get less anxious.

candidates.statement: Keep the existing per-chapter time-remaining display in the reading application.
candidates.modality: 对现有功能的正面评价（very cool feature）

evidence_candidates.quote: So one interesting feature inside the kindle application. It's that the application actually tells you how much time it's remaining for the chapter.

candidates.statement: Provide a student personal library where valuable course PDFs can be stored and kept accessible after the course ends.
candidates.modality: 明确希望（it will be very valuable）
context: course material disappears when the semester or course ends

evidence_candidates.quote: So I think it will be relevant for at least have, like a some sort of a inside library, like a student library, where you can actually store like relevant content, you know.
so I think it will be very valuable if we can, as students save them into a personal library.

candidates.statement: Save valuable resources so they can be checked later, for work or for re-reading.
candidates.modality: 明确希望（ranked as the second feature）

evidence_candidates.quote: to save these valuable resources, you know, to save these valuable resources somewhere to for me to be able to check them later

candidates.statement: Categorize and filter readings by time, such as month or year, so material can be found by when it was read.
candidates.modality: 明确希望（I would love to see）

evidence_candidates.quote: I would love to actually have like a way to yeah, to categorize in time, like, you know, sometimes you want to search like some filter filtering, and you want to search like I don't know, either by the the month or the year.
I read this in my course of spring 2023.

candidates.statement: Have the school provide its own online reading application where articles sent by professors are directly readable on the iPad.

evidence_candidates.quote: In this case the school should have its own application for for online reading right? That will be interesting.

candidates.statement: Have the school reading application included rather than paid for separately.

evidence_candidates.quote: Oh, pay! I don't know already. Pay a lot of money. They should be included, you know.
